summary.text: Rick Hansen is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 53B, where Ballotpedia lists the current tenure as beginning in 2005, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Republican Patti Mikulski is also on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Rick Hansen earned a B.S. in Biology from Upper Iowa University and an M.S. in Soil Management from Iowa State University.

His professional experience includes working as an organic farmer and co-owner of Harmony Cedar, Inc.; he previously worked for the Minnesota Department of Agriculture from 1988 to 2005, including as supervisor of the Pesticide Applicator Certification and Training Program.
Rick Hansen won re-election in 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024, most recently defeating Republican Aaron Brooksby on November 5, 2024.

Hansen's 2025-2026 committee assignments included the Agriculture Finance and Policy Committee (as Co-Chair), the Environment and Natural Resources Finance and Policy Committee and the House Capital Investment Committee.
